title: Reaction to Communion cover at Beth Israel

tellings.quote: and when I saw the face on the cover I flipped out.

plain: A man named Jim Weiner says that sometime between 1987 and 1989, at Beth Israel Hospital in Boston, he saw the cover of Communion, the writer Whitley Strieber's book about his own encounters with beings, and "when I saw the face on the cover I flipped out." He tells Michels this as something that happened to him. His shock suggests the face looked like something he had seen himself.
